'''Vrelnid''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] with vast fields of [[Alazhi/Legends|alazhi]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] at the base of a small [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range. A processing plant and a small [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] village were also located nearby.
